# E0207: local named after an imported module

A local can't take the name of an imported module, since `fs.exists` would then mean two things. Rename the local.

- Rule: [`program.one-value-namespace`](../../reference/04-programs.md#program.one-value-namespace)
- Reported at: the binding's name.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0207:4
use std.fs

fn main() / io {
  let fs = "notes.txt"
  print(fs)
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
use std.fs

fn main() / io {
  let path = "notes.txt"
  print(path)
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0207_local_named_after_an_imported_module.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0207_local_named_after_an_imported_module.lt):

```text
── LOCAL NAMED AFTER AN IMPORTED MODULE ── E0207_local_named_after_an_imported_module.lt:4:7  [E0207]

`fs` is the name of an imported module:

  4 │   let fs = "notes.txt"
    │       ^^

A local can't take the name of an imported module, since `fs.exists` would then
mean two things. Rename the local.
```
